spans.s:
m. (-टः)
1 The Malaya mountain.
2 A dog.
n. (-टं)
The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)

r. 1st cl. (जक्षति 3rd plu. जक्षति)
1 To eat.
2 To laugh.
(इ) जक्षि (जंक्षते)
1 To give.
2 To go.

n. (-णं)
Eating.
E.
जक्ष to eat, affix ल्युट्.

f. (-क्षिः)
Eating.
E.
जक्ष to eat, कि aff.

mfn. (-वान्-क्षुषी-वत्)
Eating, who eats.
E.
जक्ष to eat, वसु aff.

m. (-क्ष्मः)
Consumption, decline: see the next.

m. (-क्ष्मा)
Consumption, phthisis.
E.
यक्ष to worship, and मनिन् affix; ज is substituted for the semivowel; also यक्ष्मन्, and with a final vowel जक्ष्म.
